Explore a brand new digital experience. Introduction: Traditional app locking software often limits your app usage to specific time slots. However, our new locking app offers a fresh approach to management. Rather than setting lockout periods, we allow you to set open time slots, granting you freedom to use the app during these periods. The app automatically locks during other times, helping you manage your time better and increase your work and life efficiency. Features: Open Time Slot Management: Set the time slots during which you want to use the app, taking control of its availability. Automatic Locking: Automatically lock the app outside of open time slots to avoid unnecessary distractions. Personalized Settings: Customize open time slots according to your needs, adapting flexibly to different life and work patterns. Increased Efficiency: Effectively manage app usage time, focus on work or relax, and improve life and work efficiency. Target Audience: Individuals who need to control their app usage time. Professionals looking to increase work efficiency and focus. Students and workers who want to concentrate on studying or working during specific time slots.
